notes.content:
<Hell Shooter Update Notice – January 16>

[Clutch Bag] doesn't seem to work correctly, or there might be a maximum value that isn’t displayed. Currently, with 263,210G in gold, the attack power should increase by 13,160.5 as indicated, but it’s only shown as 225.

Fix: After reviewing the Clutch Bag effect, we found that gaining too much gold caused the damage to increase exponentially. Therefore, we adjusted it so that gaining gold increases attack power by 1 instead.
Occasionally, due to a multiplier error, the decimal points are displayed up to five places (e.g., .9999). We’ve restricted decimal point display to two places where feasible.

When using [Sundial] with a critical hit rate of 60%, pressing esc to check if the critical hit rate is applied shows it remains at 60%. It’s unclear whether it’s actually applied, exceeds 100% and doesn’t apply, or is applied but not displayed. This issue has been fixed.

Refreshed and adjusted vending machine elements.

Hell Shooter Official Release Announcement

Hell Shooter is finally getting its official release! The game will launch on January 8th at 10:00 AM KST.

Korea Standard Time (KST): January 8th, 10:00 AM
Pacific Standard Time (PST): January 7th, 5:00 PM
Eastern Standard Time (EST): January 7th, 8:00 PM
Greenwich Mean Time (GMT): January 8th, 1:00 AM
Central European Time (CET): January 8th, 2:00 AM
Australian Eastern Standard Time (AEST): January 8th, 12:00 PM

About Hell Shooter
Hell Shooter is a roguelike dungeon exploration game featuring a unique attack system, exhilarating action, and an atmospheric portrayal of Eastern-style hell. Each character also comes with its own compelling story.

What’s New in the Full Version
The official version includes over 100 different items to discover and enjoy, adding layers of variety and fun to the gameplay. All of this and more has been fully implemented for the official release.

We hope you’ll dive in and enjoy the experience!

notes.title: We have two exciting updates to share with you today.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195573/c7ba33970da54c7b816b4a06180f030ce59c1da4.png[/img]

Hello, this is Play Mephisto Waltz, the game development studio. 
We have two exciting updates to share with you today.

The first news is about the latest update for <Hell Shooter>.
(1) A new floor, the Gluttony Layer, has been added.
(2) New mid-bosses and bosses have been introduced.
(3) Visual updates have been made to the lobby and all layers of Hell.
(4) Various item-related bugs have been fixed.
(5) Attack and hit effect visuals have been improved.

The second news is the official release announcement. The official release will take place on January 6 at 11:30 AM KST (January 5 at 6:30 PM PST). The price will increase, so take this opportunity to purchase the game and enjoy the update!
